basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer from Toronto, Canada, who recently discovered the joys of geocaching. I love exploring the outdoors and combining it with my interest in technology. On weekdays, I usually work from 9 AM to 5 PM, but I often check Reddit during my lunch break or in the evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends either hiking or working on personal coding projects. I have a mild case of psoriasis, which led me to explore and engage with communities discussing skin care and health.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for the past five years. My interest in geocaching started as a way to get more physical activity and take a break from screen time. I also enjoy learning about urban development and environmental conservation, which I explore through the GrowingCanada subreddit.
